items.item: `Sources/CSS Standard/Color+sRGB.swift`: the initializer from `W3C_CSS_Values.HexColor` turns hex t
items.reason: Started from backlog-stashes/swift-css-standard.patch (applied cleanly on cd2dde1, checked against the issue): IEC_61966.2.1.SRGB.init?(_: HexColor) is failable and accepts only 3/4/6/8 hex digits; the .hex case of init?(_: Color) propagates nil. README law and doc comment updated; test pins #zzz, 5 digits, empty, 10 digits and Color.hex(#zzz).

notes: No caller outside this package passes a HexColor to the sRGB initializer (swift-html DarkModeColor.swift:18,35 uses the Color initializer, already failable).
